subject.title: fix(tasks): preserve restored flow controller provenance

question: Should historical managed-flow records with no stored controller be preserved as unknown provenance rather than being normalized to the synthetic `core/legacy-restored` controller?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive interpretation of shipped persisted state and determines the durable operator-visible ownership model for restored flows.

options.title: Adopt unknown provenance
options.body: Approve the SQL-NULL and absent-field model, then require a rebase and visible after-fix proof before landing.

options.title: Retain the synthetic owner
options.body: Keep the existing normalization only if maintainers consider the sentinel a documented ownership contract and can justify that contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt unknown provenance
recommendation.body: Approve the SQL-NULL and absent-field model, then require a rebase and visible after-fix proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They assembled the affected restore, persistence, CLI, and cancellation evidence and can clarify the intended historical-state contract.
